rationale.headline: Blending all 8 models and correcting for known group-stage biases, Brazil is the call here at about 51%.

drivers.label: Consensus of all models
drivers.detail: The eight model views are pooled into one balanced consensus before any adjustment, which favours Brazil at 60%.

drivers.label: Bias correction
drivers.detail: The consensus is nudged to fix biases the models showed on group matches of this type, shifting Brazil's win chance by -8.8 points.

rationale.methodNote: Market-blind: equal-weight linear (arithmetic) opinion pool of all 8 model views (seven base models + the stacked ensemble), then MCBoost multicalibration (alpha=0.15, 5 correction round(s)) learned on the group stage across overlapping style/strength subgroups, replayed on this fixture and bounded to within 12pp per outcome of the consensus, then a knockout 90-minute draw calibration (target ~31% draws, the 2022 Qatar knockout rate) lifting the draw on even ties. No betting or market-implied probabilities were used at any stage.
